research_question.question: Does fixed deletion of addressed-record attention messages into later prefix positions before the block-15 setter yield useful, low-harm correction, mediated by regenerated layer-16..23 values?
research_question.hypothesis: A pre-update copying route contributes to the later history-sensitive computation.
research_question.target_variable: Historical bound-target correction with originally correct direct and other-joint controls retained; conditional final eight-history repair and factorial endpoints.
research_question.expected_positive: All five historical gate components pass, followed by the fixed fresh-case and mechanism criteria.
research_question.expected_falsifying_result: Failure of the declared screen closes this specific actionable intervention branch, not every upstream hypothesis.
research_question.practical_threshold: At least 3 distinct K corrections, at least 1 per seed, at least 2 more than SCTRL, lower joint error than N, and at most 2pp new direct errors.

capability_delta.runnable_behavior: Prefix-only native attention-message subtraction and fixed norm-matched permutation; exact edited-record identity; regenerated-cache 2x2 values-only assembly.
capability_delta.interface: Frozen capsule src/puf_worker.py and src/puf_replay.py; portable tools/replay_bundle.py.
capability_delta.actual_measurement: Both seeds completed 4 technical designs and the entire 16-case historical panel.
capability_delta.not_capability_evidence: 29 CPU tests, import-recovery regression tests, guards and documentation are verification/infrastructure rather than repair success.

evidence_topology.clustering: Histories, questions, formats and seeds are repeated measurements within each of 16 exposed designs; none is an independent population replicate.
evidence_topology.exposure: The screen deliberately reused previously observed positive cases. New inputs and rules were frozen before new neural results. No concurrent-study outcomes were read.
evidence_topology.sessions: One goal owner and two isolated seed workers, with two technical runtime attempts. Not independent model actors or independent replications.

empirical_result.calibration: No calibration claim; full-vocabulary log probabilities and validity flags are retained.

negative_and_surprising_evidence.negative: K had no qualifying correction in seed 0 and increased both direct and joint errors; SCTRL remained close to original accuracy.
negative_and_surprising_evidence.technical_failures_retained: R1 false norm-reduction equality assertion; applied-region diagnostic corrected before the successful screen. Later local import-shadowing error was recovered without remote restart.
negative_and_surprising_evidence.sign_change_from_development: Not estimable: no confirmatory final sample was admitted.
negative_and_surprising_evidence.omissions: No failed case or invalid response was deleted. All conditional unrun outputs are marked inapplicable, not zero.

held_fixed.execution: Native BF16 SDPA backbone, FP32 writer/readout, both stored INV_PAIR_NLL seeds, post-block-15 setter, source prompts, 34 questions, labels and references.
held_fixed.treatment: Layers 0..15; all three addressed clauses; identical common trailing prefix S; fixed per-head signed permutation; no layer/head/strength search.
held_fixed.factorial: Original/treatment backgrounds crossed with original/treatment-generated values at layers 16..23 at S. Keys and outside-mask values stay with background.
held_fixed.boundary: Exact source inputs and post-setter record activations, no clamp, no question/gold/reference activation input, hooks absent during serving.
held_fixed.forecast: Both measured 1.25x forecasts fit. Resource time did not cause the no-go.

competing_explanations.explanation: The deleted messages carry useful computation as well as any obsolete content.
competing_explanations.evidence_for: New direct and joint errors despite exact edited-record preservation; the norm-matched control did not show comparable harm.
competing_explanations.evidence_against: K still corrected three historical cases, so effects were not uniformly harmful.
competing_explanations.what_current_data_cannot_distinguish: Useful-signal removal versus obsolete-content removal at the same edges.
competing_explanations.smallest_discriminating_test: An externally specified intervention separating useful from obsolete information, with fresh frozen controls; not authorized here.
competing_explanations.prediction_under_that_test: Preserving useful messages could reduce harm if this explanation is correct.
competing_explanations.confidence: Plausible, not identified by this screen.

competing_explanations.explanation: The selected direct route is insufficient or is not the useful cause of the history effect.
competing_explanations.evidence_for: No seed-0 correction and no two-case advantage over SCTRL; the declared gate failed.
competing_explanations.evidence_against: Three seed-1 corrections and nontrivial answer changes leave some influence possible.
competing_explanations.what_current_data_cannot_distinguish: A genuinely irrelevant route versus a relevant route masked by collateral disruption or parallel computation.
competing_explanations.smallest_discriminating_test: Independent selective causal evidence for the proposed route, under a new externally frozen protocol; not another run of this terminal screen.
competing_explanations.prediction_under_that_test: A sufficient useful route would show consistent low-harm correction; irrelevance would not.
competing_explanations.confidence: The actionable procedure is rejected by its gate; the broader cause remains unresolved.

barrier_audit.falsifier: A verified error in the fixed data, implementation or gate computation; independent CPU replay found none.
barrier_audit.confidence: High for the fixed procedural disposition, not for universal causal absence.

barrier_audit.evidence: Zero fresh final cases and zero final repeats were admitted.

barrier_audit.falsifier: An authorized, complete fresh-case artifact matching the relevant claim; absent here.
barrier_audit.confidence: High; no population or confirmatory mechanism claim is made.

barrier_audit.evidence: Two narrowly diagnosed technical/controller incidents, both resolved without changing the scientific procedure.
